headline: Riot is ending development on its League of Legends fighting game
summary: Riot Games will cease active development on its fighting game 2XKO by late 2026. The decision follows insufficient player retention less than a year after launch. Servers will remain online, but no new content will be developed.

headline: The Genesis GV90 blows the bloody doors off what's possible in EV design
summary: Hyundai's luxury brand Genesis unveiled its striking new GV90 electric SUV. The three-row EV features wild designs, including unique coach-style doors. It aims to redefine luxury and design possibilities in the EV market.

headline: Mark Zuckerberg bought an Irish castle
summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg and his wife purchased Strancally Castle in Ireland. The estate spans 440 acres and cost an estimated €20-30 million. Zuckerberg now officially owns a historic Irish castle.

headline: Australia says Roblox hasn't fixed its child predator problem
summary: Australia's eSafety regulator claims Roblox still has child safety issues. Concerns include insufficient measures to prevent adult-child contact. Roblox has pledged further changes to its safety features.

headline: Riot to End Active Development for 2XKO in December 2026, Online Play to Remain Unaffected
summary: Riot's League of Legends fighting game, 2XKO, will end active development by December 2026. This halt impacts future content but online play will continue. The decision is a significant setback for the game's development.

headline: Dan Aykroyd Reveals What the Original Ghostbusters Costumes Looked Like
summary: Ghostbusters co-creator Dan Aykroyd revealed early costume designs. Original concepts for the 1984 film featured the team wearing helmets. Aykroyd shared these insights via a post on X.

headline: Thrilljoy Reveals Terrifying Cute IT: Welcome to Derry Pennywise Figures
summary: Thrilljoy unveiled new "cute" Pennywise vinyl figures from IT: Welcome to Derry. Part of the PIX! line, they offer a unique, less terrifying take on the clown. These collectibles aim to reimagine the iconic horror character.

headline: The New 2026 58" Hisense QD50 Smart TV Offers QLED Image Quality and Built-In Roku for Less Than $200
summary: Hisense is launching a 58-inch QD50 Smart TV with QLED quality. The 2026 model includes built-in Roku and costs under $200. It's touted as an outstanding value, ideal for back-to-school.

headline: Harry and Meghan's return to UK reignites questions over security
summary: Prince Harry and Meghan's UK return sparks security funding debate. A new decision is needed on their publicly funded protection entitlement. Their surprise announcement brings renewed scrutiny on royal security.

headline: What does Harry's return mean for his fractured relationship with William?
summary: Prince Harry's UK return prompts questions about his bond with William. The royal brothers have experienced a strained relationship for years. This visit could significantly impact their future dynamic.

headline: Five key takeaways from GCSE results day 2026
summary: GCSE results day 2026 saw an increase in resits nationwide. The achievement gap between boys and girls has notably narrowed. However, England's regional educational divide has widened.

headline: US says sanctions will 'squash' Iran's economy and 'collapse' its regime
summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent declared sanctions will crush Iran's economy. The US aims for Iran's regime to collapse under economic pressure. Bessent challenged allies to choose between supporting or opposing the US stance.
